title: Generic boss
text: Each preset against a level 63 boss with no creature type. Since client 70425, no racial depends on the weapon.

title: Beast target
text: A Beast boss turns on Troll Beast Slaying and Dwarf Big Game Hunter (5% more damage).

title: Elemental target
text: An Elemental boss turns on High Order and Windshaper Elemental Insight (5% more damage).

title: Humanoid target
text: Priests only. Dwarf Priests cast Chastise, which works only on Humanoids. No other racial cares about Humanoids.

title: Racials off
text: Every race on its base stats, with all racials left out.

title: The Human Spirit
text: Spirit increased by 5%.
short: Spirit increased by 5%.

title: Ruthless
text: +2% critical strike chance with all spells and attacks, with any weapon (swords only before client 70425).
short: +2% critical strike chance with all spells and attacks, with any weapon (swords only before client 70425).

title: Earth Fury
text: Critical strike bonus to damage and healing increased by 2% (+1% crit with a mace before client 70425).
short: Critical strike bonus to damage and healing increased by 2% (+1% crit with a mace before client 70425).

title: Savage
text: +1% critical strike chance with all spells and abilities, with any weapon (axes only before client 70425).
short: +1% critical strike chance with all spells and abilities, with any weapon (axes only before client 70425).

title: Elune's Light
text: +10% critical strike chance for 15s, 3 min cooldown.
short: +10% critical strike chance for 15s, 3 min cooldown.

title: Expansive Mind
text: Maximum Mana, Rage or Energy increased by 5%.
short: Maximum Mana, Rage or Energy increased by 5%.

title: Eureka!
text: For 8s, direct damage abilities cost 10% less and deal 10% more damage (DoTs too for Warlocks, heals too for Priests), 2 min cooldown.
short: For 8s, direct damage abilities cost 10% less and deal 10% more damage (DoTs too for Warlocks, heals too for Priests), 2 min cooldown.

title: Blood Fury
text: Attack power and spell power increased by 10% for 15s, 3 min cooldown.
short: Attack power and spell power increased by 10% for 15s, 3 min cooldown.

title: Touch of the Grave
text: Spells and attacks have a 20% chance (30% for Mages, Priests and Warlocks) to deal Shadow damage equal to 5% of your maximum health and heal you for it. At most once every 25s, and it cannot crit.
short: 20% chance a hit (30% for Mages, Priests and Warlocks) to deal Shadow damage equal to 5% of max health. At most once every 25s.

title: Endurance
text: Health increased by 5% and critical strike bonus to damage and healing increased by 2% (+1% hit before client 70425).
short: Health increased by 5% and critical strike bonus to damage and healing increased by 2% (+1% hit before client 70425).

title: Berserking
text: Attack and casting speed increased by 10% for 10s, 3 min cooldown.
short: Attack and casting speed increased by 10% for 10s, 3 min cooldown.

title: Wind Blessed
text: Spellcasting, melee and ranged haste increased by 3% (1% before client 70425).
short: Spellcasting, melee and ranged haste increased by 3% (1% before client 70425).

title: Big Game Hunter
text: Damage dealt versus Beasts increased by 5%.
short: Damage dealt versus Beasts increased by 5%.

title: Beast Slaying
text: Damage dealt versus Beasts increased by 5%.
short: Damage dealt versus Beasts increased by 5%.

title: Elemental Insight
text: Damage dealt versus Elementals increased by 5%.
short: Damage dealt versus Elementals increased by 5%.

title: Chastise
text: Dwarf Priests: an instant Holy hit on a Humanoid, 2 min cooldown.
short: Dwarf Priests: an instant Holy hit on a Humanoid, 2 min cooldown.

title: Starshards
text: Night Elf Priests: Arcane damage over 6s, 30s cooldown.
short: Night Elf Priests: Arcane damage over 6s, 30s cooldown.

title: Dark Sacrifice
text: Undead Priests: trade health for mana over 15s, 10 min cooldown.
short: Undead Priests: trade health for mana over 15s, 10 min cooldown.

title: Base stats
text: The race's own stats, with no racials.
short: The race's own stats, with no racials.

title: Target type
text: Racials, talents and spells that work only on this creature type.
short: Racials, talents and spells that work only on this creature type.

title: Warrior
text: Orc is best on every Warrior preset. High Order is next, 0.5% behind on Fury. High Order Wind Blessed is the biggest racial on Fury, +17.0 DPS (1.7%). Against Beasts, Dwarf leads Fury (+5.3% vs the generic boss), 0.4% ahead of Troll. Against Elementals, High Order and Windshaper lead Fury (+5.3% vs the generic boss), 4.5% ahead of Orc.

title: Rogue
text: Windshaper is best on Combat Swords, Combat Daggers, Seal Fate Daggers, Mutilate and Seal Fate Swords. Orc is best on Subtlety. High Order Wind Blessed is the biggest racial on Combat Swords, +12.6 DPS (1.7%). Against Beasts, Dwarf leads Combat Swords (+5.0% vs the generic boss), 0.4% ahead of Troll. Against Elementals, High Order and Windshaper lead Combat Swords (+5.0% vs the generic boss), 5.2% ahead of Undead.

title: Hunter
text: Windshaper is best on Lone Wolf, Marksmanship and Beast Mastery. Human is best on Survival. Windshaper Wind Blessed is the biggest racial on Lone Wolf, +24.1 DPS (2.2%). Against Beasts, Dwarf leads Lone Wolf (+5.0% vs the generic boss), 0.1% ahead of Troll.

title: Paladin
text: Human is best on every Paladin preset. Undead is next, 0.2% behind on Ret Shock. Human Ruthless is the biggest racial on Ret Shock, +10.7 DPS (1.2%). Against Beasts, Dwarf leads Ret Shock (+4.2% vs the generic boss), 3.5% ahead of Human.

title: Shaman
text: Orc is best on Enhancement, Enh Imp GW, Enh Water Shield and Enh Mana Tide. Windshaper is best on Elemental and Elemental Mana Tide. The best Alliance race on Enhancement is Dwarf, 1.0% behind. Windshaper Wind Blessed is the biggest racial on Enhancement, +10.6 DPS (1.3%). Against Beasts, Dwarf leads Enhancement (+5.0% vs the generic boss), 0.3% ahead of Troll. Against Elementals, Windshaper leads Enhancement (+5.0% vs the generic boss), 4.4% ahead of Orc.

title: Druid
text: Tauren is best on every Druid preset. Night Elf is next, 0.2% behind on Balance. Tauren Endurance is the biggest racial on Balance, +10.3 DPS (1.2%). Against Elementals, High Order and Windshaper lead Balance (+5.0% vs the generic boss), 3.9% ahead of Tauren.

title: Mage
text: Human is best on Frostfire, Fire and Arcane. High Order is best on Frost. The best Horde race on Frostfire is Orc, 0.6% behind. Human Ruthless is the biggest racial on Frostfire, +21.8 DPS (2.2%). High Order Wind Blessed costs 4.7 DPS on Fire. Against Beasts, Troll leads Frostfire (+5.0% vs the generic boss), 2.7% ahead of Human. Against Elementals, High Order leads Frostfire (+5.0% vs the generic boss), 4.5% ahead of Human.

title: Warlock
text: Human is best on every Warlock preset. Orc is next, 0.4% behind on Demonology. Human Ruthless is the biggest racial on Demonology, +21.5 DPS (1.9%). Against Beasts, Troll leads Demonology (+4.4% vs the generic boss), 2.6% ahead of Human.

title: Priest
text: Human is best on Shadow and Shadow + Holy. Undead is best on Smite. The best Horde race on Shadow is Undead, 0.8% behind. Human Ruthless is the biggest racial on Shadow, +14.9 DPS (1.6%). Against Beasts, Dwarf leads Shadow (+5.0% vs the generic boss), 1.1% ahead of Troll.
